audit.why: Levels 2-3 favour Jayce (gate-Q outranges Overload's 1000 range), 4-6 even, and Ryze takes over on mana items. Matches the 51.01% Emerald+ figure over 990 games: Jayce wins lane, Ryze wins the game.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gives Jayce both item stages, but the page's own prose says 'This is where Ryze takes the lane' and 'His window' at 2+ items.
audit.why: Internal contradiction: win[5]/win[6] and phases[5]/[6].side say Jayce while every why/spike/breakdown line for those stages says Ryze. Reference chart in the packet reads Ryze at both.
audit.corrected: win[5]=Ryze, win[6]=Ryze and the matching phases sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every line calls Rune Prison (W) a root. Riot's text: Rune Prison damages and SLOWS; it only roots if Spell Flux is already on the target.
audit.why: This changes the whole dodge priority — the punishable cast is Spell Flux (E), not the W. Ryze W is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, Spell Flux is 3.5s down to 2.5s, so you cannot dodge the E forever, but you can refuse to be Fluxed before he has W up.
audit.corrected: State the Flux prerequisite: no Flux on you, no root.

audit.why: Rune Prison is 11s at rank 1 falling to 9s; Realm Warp is 180/160/140s. Jayce's Acceleration Gate is 20s at rank 1, which is what actually gates his poke cadence.
audit.corrected: Add gate/W numbers to the trading advice.

edits.before: Save your Hextech Capacitor swap-burst of move speed to dodge his Rune Prison root -- if you eat the W, his Flux/Overload reset combo chunks you before you can kite
edits.after: Dodge Spell Flux (E), not the W -- Rune Prison only roots a target already carrying Flux, otherwise it is just a slow you can swap-walk out of with Hextech Capacitor move speed

edits.before: Ryze just wants to last-hit and survive, so make the early lane miserable: at Level 2 your gate-Q (Shock Blast fired through Acceleration Gate) badly out-ranges his Overload, and a Mercury Cannon swap-auto shreds his armor/MR the instant he steps up for a minion. Cannon-Q his step-ups, then swap to Hammer for the To-the-Skies into Lightning Field into Thundering Blow burst if he's caught flat-footed. Respect Rune Prison (his W) -- it's the root that sets up his Flux/Overload combo -- so only commit when your Hextech Capacitor swap-dash is up to break range right after.
edits.after: Ryze just wants to last-hit and survive, so make the early lane miserable: at Level 2 your gate-Q (Shock Blast fired through Acceleration Gate) badly out-ranges his 1000-range Overload, and a Mercury Cannon swap-auto shreds his armor/MR the instant he steps up for a minion. Cannon-Q his step-ups, then swap to Hammer for the To-the-Skies into Lightning Field into Thundering Blow burst if he's caught flat-footed. Rune Prison (W) only ROOTS if Spell Flux (E) is already on you -- unfluxed it is a slow, so sidestep the E and his 11s W stops being a death sentence.

edits.before: Rune Prison, his shield and Flux resets come online so he can trade back into your poke -- hold gate-Q range and only commit when your swap-dash is up to break the root.
edits.after: Rune Prison, his shield and Flux resets come online -- but the W only roots through an existing Spell Flux, so dodge the E and hold gate-Q range on your 20s gate.

notes: Ryze's Rune Prison is a slow, not a root, unless Spell Flux is already applied — the whole page treated it as an unconditional root. Left the mid/late/breakdown 'root' wording alone where rewriting would have broken the length band; flagged for a later pass. 'Realm Warps' in wants.you[2] is a false-positive suspect (verb form of Realm Warp) and was left as-is.
